continuity_scope: EverQuest's 21 July 2021 live-service Overseer Packs update, bounded to its official 'New Agent Examples' entries and the one named opponent directly stated there. This is neither a 16 March 1999 launch-era pass nor a general Norrath chronology; it does not merge the original game, its expansion eras, progression-server unlock states, EverQuest II, player-created characters, or later/earlier live patches.
work_or_witnesses: Daybreak EverQuest, New Overseer Packs Now Available!, 21 July 2021
Daybreak EverQuest, Overseer and you, March 2020, Overseer-system/player-choice boundary only
Daybreak EverQuest, 17 Years of EverQuest: What's YOUR Story?, 16 March 2016, original-launch date boundary only
coverage_rule: All four individually named figures directly described as 'New Agent Examples' in the 21 July 2021 official update—Avatar of Bristlebane, Avatar of Xegony, General Jyleel, and Xicotl—plus Ambassador D’Vinn, the sole named dramatic individual directly identified as General Jyleel's mortal enemy. This closure permits the one directly stated named-character relationship without an orphan endpoint. Deities themselves are not converted into character records: the included Bristlebane and Xegony records are their separately named avatars on Norrath. Player-created adventurers/Overseers and unlisted agents are excluded.
omissions: All player-created adventurers and their names, race/class/persona choices, levels, groups, quests, achievements, agent selections, success/failure states, rewards, and server-specific progress.

Every named NPC, deity, avatar, monster, agent, item, zone, class, race, faction, expansion, or historical event not directly described in the selected New Agent Examples entries, including Bristlebane and Xegony as deities rather than their named Norrathian avatars.

EverQuest's 1999 launch build, every expansion and time-locked-progression era, original/manual text, EverQuest II, retconned or later Agent Lore text, later or earlier patches, localizations, adaptations, fan wikis, Wikipedia, walkthroughs, and community databases.
uncertainties: This is an official gameplay-update roster, not a character encyclopedia or a narrative chapter. It supplies concise agent-lore statements only; pass completion is limited to the stated four examples plus D’Vinn relationship closure.

The post says several Agent Lore texts received grammatical fixes and that an agent's lore text was updated for a disguise. This demonstrates that live-service textual presentation can change; no claim is extended beyond the dated update wording.
The 2020 system overview says players choose which agents they possess and send on Overseer quests, so agent availability and player selections are not universalized as story relationships or states.
The update is in English. The source does not establish identical names, titles, punctuation, or lore wording across every localization or client build.

The 2016 Daybreak anniversary post supplies a 16 March 1999 original-launch date only; it is not evidence for the 2021 entries or proof of unbroken lore identity across the intervening live-service history.
evidence_basis: Direct official EverQuest/Daybreak update text, augmented only with official source pages for launch-date and Overseer-system boundaries. No fan-created resource is used as canonical evidence.
